_provenance: Gate mechanism (routing + balanced-JSON parse + threshold contract) adapted from bkit (popup-studio-ai/bkit-claude-code, Apache-2.0) lib/application/quality-gates/measure-router.js + bkit.config.json. Adapted for cowork: deterministic gates run directly (no agent), thresholds resolve project-override > this catalog > fallback. See NOTICE.

G-BUILD.note: value=100 only if ALL commands succeed; any non-zero exit → 0. Override commands per repo (e.g. web tsc+build, custom runner).

G-CONTRACT.sourceArtifact: advertised contract surfaces mutual consistency (e.g. inputSchema <-> validate <-> outputSchema <-> guide text <-> consumers). Report count of surfaces that disagree.
G-CONTRACT.when: any contract change (schema, signature, MCP tool, CLI flag, error/message)

G-MATCH.sourceArtifact: design/spec declared WorkList items vs actual shipped implementation (read logic, not grep — catch stubs/placeholders)

G-CRIT.sourceArtifact: adversarial multi-lens review (correctness + dominant-risk lens: security/concurrency/data-integrity). Report count of HIGH-CONFIDENCE Critical findings only.
G-CRIT.when: before any irreversible/production action (deploy, migration, mass-delete)

commands.cmd: git diff --cached -- '*migration*' '*migrations*' | grep -iE '^\+.*(drop table|drop column|truncate|delete from|alter table.*drop|alter column.*type|rename)' | grep -viv '__test_' | wc -l | tr -d ' '
commands.label: destructive keyword scan (staged)

G-MIGRATE.when: DB migration / db push (pairs with manual before/after row-count review)
G-MIGRATE.note: grep is the deterministic half; the human before/after count review still applies (migration-safety-review rule).

G-INTENT.sourceArtifact: did the execution serve the INTENT behind the plan (not merely literal compliance)? Return 100 if PASS, 0 if intent-drift/false-completion found.
G-INTENT.when: after QA gate passes, before deploy/deliver

G-DOCSYNC.sourceArtifact: docs (LIVING authority + status-claim labels) vs current code/deploy state
G-DOCSYNC.note: skill-backed: run /cowork-doc-sync; drift count = surfaces it had to update.
